Title: Drop redundant escaping in redirect

Description:
The location is already URL-encoded with iri_to_uri when the Location header is set, so escaping it again for the HTML body is redundant.

arguments.summary: The pull request removes html escaping of the location in `redirect()` because `iri_to_uri` is applied to the Location header by Response, making escaping in the HTML body redundant and safe to omit.
